headline: Oblivion M14 development update
summary: Oblivion continues as an independent community fork of LeviLauncher Android. This update improves native loading diagnostics, makes English the first-install language, and updates user-visible product identity.

items.text: Native library load failures now retain their linker error details for troubleshooting.
New installations use English by default while saved language choices remain respected.
Oblivion branding is used in launcher-owned screens while upstream and third-party attribution is retained.
